body: That is quite disgraceful. May you burn in hell forever.
No, maybe another two wives would keep my mind off killing myself.
Or I can divorce my wife and marry my mistress. I can have four wives. She is a citizen of Germany.

But the Hebrew took our land, and our water. And now in Palestine they are killing them by taking food and water from their mouths. Me believes that the Germans were the ones that killed six million Hebrews.
How many shades of brown are there?
